title: kms-usage-provenance-and-stable-audit-proxy
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers asked for unambiguous billing provenance for KMS operations and stronger guarantees that audit records survive cross-region failovers without misattribution. This PR implements a lightweight KMS usage provenance tagger plus an opt-in Audit Consistency Proxy that enforces ordered, idempotent audit writes and emits signed checkpoints. Key changes: 1) services/kms: introduce an annotator that emits X-Redwood-KMS-Tag header with canonical tuple (service_id|region|purpose|nonce) derived from tenant claims and routing decisions; the nonce is HMAC(service_signing_key, timestamp|tenant_id) to prevent replay and spoofing; 2) audit/proxy: new service that buffers per-tenant audit envelopes, verifies monotonic sequence windows, signs checkpoints to an audit index, and exposes a health/metrics endpoint for backpressure monitoring; 3) pkg/rbac: add residency.kms-controller role and RBAC v2 mappings preventing non-region-anchored operators from modifying tagger or proxy configuration; 4) infra/terraform: optional module to deploy the proxy behind a regional gateway; 5) web/console: admin toggle and rollout controls for audit.consistency.enabled. Backwards compatibility: the tagging header is additive and ignored by legacy components; the proxy is disabled by default for gradual rollout. Rollout plan: enable in a single region for canary tenants, monitor checkpoint latency and audit sink throughput, then expand regions. Rollback: flip audit.consistency.enabled to false to bypass proxy and restore best-effort forwarding. Security considerations: tags are signed at the perimeter to prevent operator spoofing; proxy verifies signatures before accepting envelopes. Migration notes: SQL migration adds the residency.kms-controller role and is idempotent with dry-run support. This PR references ENG-1219 and the SUP-3421 incident postmortem.
commits: Add kms annotator and unit tests; Implement audit consistency proxy and per-tenant queue; Add RBAC v2 policy templates and idempotent migration script; Terraform: optional audit proxy module and smoke test; Console: admin toggle and rollout UI; Docs: security/kms-audit-proxy.md; Fix: handle clock skew in nonce verification; CI: increase integration timeout for proxy tests

release_notes: Introduce optional KMS usage provenance tagging (X-Redwood-KMS-Tag) and an opt-in Audit Consistency Proxy to improve billing attribution and audit delivery guarantees. Admins can enable via audit.consistency.enabled. Adds new RBAC role residency.kms-controller. Backwards compatible when disabled.
